senses.gloss:
गिष्ण m. (-ष्णः)
 1. A Brahman versed in the Sama Veda, a chanter of
that Veda, which is always to be so recited.
 2. An actor, a profes-
sional singer.
 E. गै to sing, भिष्ण Uṇādi aff.

गीष्पति m. (-तिः)
 1. A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER and
preceptor of the gods.
 2. A Pandit or learned teacher.
 E. गिर् speech,
in the nominative case, गीः and पति master, Visarga becomes स
and स is here changed irregularly to ष the compound however is
sometimes written differently, thus गीःपति, गीर्पति or गीस्पति.
